$comment: The feature flags in work (#6254, epic-lifecycle stage 6, #6253): one list, so the Mac window, the Remote and the web page read the same names. A flag is kept per person in the host's display settings as flag:<name>, a bool; off when absent. scripts/wire.sh gen writes FeatureFlag.generated.swift and flags.generated.ts from it. Keep the flags in name order; take a flag out when its feature ships.
